description: Step Builders landing page -- a discovery hub that presents all available step builder types as a card grid. Users land here to understand what kinds of automation assets they can create and navigate to the specialized builder for each type. Each card represents a distinct builder (checks, check groups, shell commands, tasks, contexts, playwright tests) with a brief description and visual icon. Clicking a card navigates to the full builder interface for that asset type.

groups.name: Page Purpose and Discovery
groups.description: The Step Builders page serves as a wayfinding hub for users who want to create reusable automation building blocks. Rather than presenting a single complex form, it shows a grid of builder cards so users can quickly identify and navigate to the right tool for the asset they want to create. The page heading and subtitle explain the purpose, and the card layout provides visual differentiation through color-coded icons. This is the entry point for all library asset creation outside of the workflow editor itself.

assertions.description: Users see a clear page heading identifying this as the Step Builders area, with a subtitle explaining that these are specialized editors for building individual workflow steps
Users see a grid of builder cards representing all available asset types, each with a descriptive title, icon, and brief explanation of what that builder creates
Users can click any builder card to navigate directly to the full builder interface for that asset type, transitioning from discovery to creation

groups.name: Available Builder Types
groups.description: The page presents six distinct builder types, each corresponding to a type of reusable asset in the automation library. Checks validate UI or system state. Check Groups bundle multiple checks into test suites. Shell Commands define reusable system commands. Tasks define automation work units with prompts. Contexts provide AI instructions and knowledge. Playwright Tests create browser automation scripts. Each builder type is visually distinguished with a unique color and icon, making it easy to scan and locate the desired builder.

assertions.description: Users can discover and navigate to the Checks builder for creating verification checks that validate UI state, with a description explaining its purpose

criteria.textContent: Verification checks for validating UI state

assertions.description: Users can discover and navigate to the Check Groups builder for bundling multiple checks into reusable test suites that run as a single verification unit
Users can discover and navigate to the Tasks builder for creating automation task definitions that serve as building blocks in workflows
Users can discover and navigate to the Contexts builder for creating reusable context configurations that provide information to AI during workflow execution
Users can discover and navigate to the Playwright Tests builder for creating browser automation tests used as verification steps in workflows

groups.name: Visual Organization and Layout
groups.description: The builder cards are arranged in a responsive grid layout that adapts to screen size, showing one to three columns depending on available width. Each card uses consistent visual structure: a color-coded icon on the left, the builder title and description on the right, and a hover-revealed arrow indicating navigability. The grid layout ensures all builder types are visible without scrolling on typical screens, providing immediate overview of all creation options.

assertions.description: Users see all builder cards arranged in a scannable grid layout that adapts to screen width, ensuring all options are discoverable without excessive scrolling
Each builder card includes a brief description explaining what the builder creates, helping users choose the right tool without needing to explore each builder
Users see a subtitle beneath the page heading explaining the purpose of step builders as specialized editors for building individual workflow steps

criteria.textContent: Build individual workflow steps with specialized editors

states.name: Builder Card Grid
states.description: The Step Builders landing page is displayed with the full card grid showing all six builder types. Each card presents an icon, title, and description. This is the only view state of the page; all navigation leads to external builder pages.
